_comment: GENERATED by scripts/export_star_data.py from a Gaia DR3 snapshot. Do not edit by hand. 'direction' is a unit vector in equatorial J2000; 'magnitude' is apparent Gaia G; 'colour' is an approximate display RGB; 'galactic' is the 3D position in parsecs with the Sun at the origin, null where the parallax was too noisy to invert.
